title: PAgP (Port Aggregation Protocol)
description: Configure Cisco-proprietary PAgP negotiation with desirable and auto modes.
scenario: Configure Cisco-proprietary PAgP negotiation with desirable and auto modes.

concepts.title: What is PAgP?
concepts.body: PAgP (Port Aggregation Protocol) is Cisco-proprietary. It negotiates an EtherChannel between two Cisco switches automatically.
concepts.code:
SW1(config)# interface range FastEthernet0/1-2
SW1(config-if-range)# channel-group 1 mode desirable

concepts.title: PAgP Modes
concepts.body: desirable actively asks to form a channel. auto passively waits for the other side to ask. on is static with no negotiation at all.
concepts.code:
desirable: initiates negotiation
auto:      responds only
on:        static, no PAgP

concepts.title: Mode Combinations
concepts.body: desirable + desirable = channel forms. desirable + auto = channel forms. auto + auto = NEVER forms (nobody asks).
concepts.code:
desirable + desirable → channel
auto + auto           → no channel!

concepts.title: Verifying PAgP
concepts.body: "show etherchannel summary" shows the channel protocol as PAgP. "show pagp neighbor" lists the PAgP partner.
concepts.code:
SW1# show etherchannel summary
Group  Port-channel  Protocol  Ports
1      Po1(SU)      PAgP      Fa0/1(P) Fa0/2(P)
